description: Read and set whether an agent answers the mail sent to its own address: GET /api/v1/agent-inboxes/:id/answering and PUT /api/v1/agent-inboxes/:id/answering, both mail.inbox-answering@1. It is OFF by default and per agent; turning it on is what makes Mail publish mail.agent_inbox.received for that address at all. The caller must act for the person (on_behalf_of), and another person's inbox is the same 404 as one that does not exist. Mail still publishes nothing for a sender on the person's block list or for a message the mail server marked as spam.
